demoted_material.note: These remain adaptation material only and do not define publication opening order.

story_unit: Luo observes a student-affairs workplace before applying
he tries again and fails again
he revises the target toward research support
he receives a modest offer and starts the job
real work adds hierarchy, student money, rules and the need to say no
only after Luo is established does an old classmate with a live decision, Gao Yuan, enter naturally through a real call
active_opening_unit.reader_memory_goal: Luo must remain memorable even if the camera later leaves him for several chapters.

opening_anchor_rule: The first memorable protagonist remains focal until desire, vulnerability, repeated action and lived consequence are established. Only then may the novel introduce another core actor through a concrete social or causal encounter.
relay_rule: Water-Margin-like relay begins after depth is achieved. One live event may expose a new person; the novel then chooses whether to stay with the old focal actor or follow the newcomer. No roster balancing, no forced handoff, no multi-core montage.
arc_rendering_rule: Campbell remains backend-only. It shapes Luo and Gao longitudinally but does not dictate chapter order or visible lessons.
nonnegotiable_rules: No adaptation hypothesis becomes ledger history.
Depth before breadth in the opening.
Do not broaden the cast before the current anchor is memorable through action and consequence.
Do not introduce a core actor because the roster says it is their turn.
Only one new core actor should normally be foregrounded at a handoff.
A background participant may appear without becoming a new protagonist.
Do not force a handoff every chapter.
Use role labels for nonrecurring guests until a name matters.
Background leaks through action, dialogue, objects, institutions, money, space and other people's reactions rather than profile paragraphs.
High education does not imply universal negotiation, leadership, emotional or social skill.
Every strong capability must have a formation source, shadow cost and high-pressure failure mode.
A virtue must be allowed to create costs; a flaw must be allowed to protect something real.
Power changes how personality is expressed; separate trait from position effect.
Campbell stages are never chapter labels, thesis dialogue or explicit self-diagnosis.
Character transformation changes probabilities, thresholds and recovery patterns; it does not permanently remove old flaws.
Every core actor retains at least one materially unresolved ambiguity at the 2035 horizon.
Do not force romance, illness, family disaster, betrayal, crime or redemption to manufacture a hook.
Do not imitate Water Margin through archaic diction or chapter-title pastiche; borrow event-driven introduction and relay mechanics only.
Do not use AI-summary endings, thesis dialogue, forced symbolism or universal self-awareness.
2035 is an observation endpoint, not a life verdict.

required_before_following_gao_for_multip: audit Chapter7 for whether Gao enters as a person with his own live problem rather than as information about a classmate
if Gao passes, follow him for at least two scenes before considering another core handoff
if Gao does not pass, keep the camera with Luo and treat the call as ordinary social texture
do not develop Zhou Ye merely because he joins the same call
keep ordinary life, money, housing, family distance and city texture visible without turning them into a checklist
next_stage_gate.drafting_rule: One core handoff at a time. No ensemble montage and no return to the old roster-driven architecture.
